title: Written on the Wall II Conjecture 40
statement: For every nontrivial finite connected simple graph G, the largest induced-forest order f(G) is at least ceil((p(G)+b(G)+1)/2), where p(G) is the minimum number of vertex-disjoint paths covering V(G) and b(G) is the largest induced-bipartite order.

counterexample.description: A finite connected simple graph whose largest induced forest is smaller than the ceiling of one half of its path-cover number plus largest induced-bipartite order plus one.
